performance.verdict: Paid channels fully dark; organic GBP collapsing — revenue engine has stalled.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — $0 Meta, $0 Google. No paid leads generated. All CPL metrics are undefined.
GBP actions collapsed: last 3 days (Aug 31–Sep 2) show 0 actions vs prior 3 days (Aug 28–30) averaging 0.33 — and vs Aug 25 peak of 11. 28-day total: 43 actions.
GA4 sessions spiked to 28 on Sep 1 vs 7-day prior average of ~6 — isolated anomaly, no corresponding GBP actions or leads; cause unknown.
205 GA4 sessions and 43 GBP actions over 28 days produced 0 pipeline entries (GHL null) and 0 GA4 conversions — intake or tracking is broken.

suggestions.text: Confirm why paid spend is $0 — verify Meta and Google accounts are live and budgets are funded.
suggestions.monday_update: Both Meta and Google Ads have recorded $0 spend across the entire 28-day window. Verify account billing, campaign status, and ad approval in both platforms immediately. Success is confirmed when daily spend appears in the dashboard for 3 consecutive days. Target resolution: 2026-09-06.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake and GA4 conversion tracking — 205 sessions and 43 GBP actions produced 0 pipeline entries.
suggestions.monday_update: Over 28 days, 205 website sessions and 43 GBP actions resulted in 0 GHL pipeline opportunities and 0 GA4 conversion events, indicating a broken form, disconnected GHL integration, or misfired conversion pixel. Test the lead form end-to-end and confirm GHL webhook is receiving submissions. Success is a non-zero GHL opportunity appearing within 48 hours of fix. Target: 2026-09-05.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP recovery: if actions remain at 0 for 3 more days, escalate to profile audit.
